execution_claims.automatic_gate_scope: process-free JSON, source-token and pure or sealed host evidence; native SDL video, EGL/GLES drivers, windows and guest code remain outside this gate

requirements.requirement: adotar Mali-450/GLES2 como piso real
requirements.claim: The default requirement floor is real GLES2 with RGB888 and double buffering; nxgl does not inject GLES3 or Mesa as a baseline.

tokens: does not require Mesa, desktop OpenGL, or GLES 3.x
GLES2 is required; optional capabilities are measured

limitations: This host gate does not open a Mali-450 driver or prove a physical GLES2 context.

requirements.requirement: distinguir ownership SDL e EGL raw
requirements.claim: API v2 distinguishes typed SDL_EGL and RAW_EGL stack owners, validates owner-coherent handles, freezes one complete provider through close and reports that owner; raw EGL is never inferred as a universal path.

tokens: stack_userdata must remain alive and valid
raw EGL may be used only
SDL owns window, context, make-current and page-flip

limitations: The automatic evidence uses caller-owned fake callbacks and userdata with the declared lifetime; it does not open fbdev, KMSDRM or Wayland.

requirements.requirement: resolver entry points do mesmo stack que abriu o contexto
requirements.claim: The SDL provider resolves through SDL_GL_GetProcAddress while its context is current; a raw provider must inject get-proc, actual-config, current-validation and present callbacks from its own frozen stack, preventing silent cross-stack linkage.

tokens: resolve EGL and GLES entry points from the same stack

limitations: The sealed boundary owns every fake function and does not load a host EGL or GLES provider.

requirements.requirement: rejeitar desktop GL quando guest exige GLES
requirements.claim: Version parsing accepts OpenGL ES spellings, records an exact desktop-GL rejection reason and allows only one scoped, transactional GLES/EGL hint recovery whose absent, empty or full prior values must be restored; on an SDL without SDL_ResetHint, an absent prior hint disables only that optional recovery and never blocks the ordinary candidate round.

tokens: request an ES profile and reject a measured desktop GL context

limitations: No Mesa, GLX, Wayland, Panfrost or historical SDL shared library is loaded by the synthetic test; ResetHint availability is injected in memory.

requirements.requirement: recriar janela por tentativa de depth/stencil quando necessário
requirements.claim: Each declared candidate reapplies every framebuffer attribute, creates its own window and drops both context and window before another candidate is attempted.

tokens: recreate the window when depth or stencil attributes change

limitations: Preflight pins the production transaction while the final synthetic retry seam remains subject to core freeze.

requirements.requirement: obter EGLConfig realmente entregue
requirements.claim: The selected provider returns a typed actual GLES/config receipt; nxgl validates its positive EGLConfig ID, the EGL renderable bit required by the requested GLES major, window capability, bounded bit fields and current-handle coherence instead of echoing the request.
limitations: The automatic EGLConfig is supplied by a sealed fake boundary, not a physical display driver.

requirements.requirement: obter drawable real positivo
requirements.claim: Opening succeeds only after the selected provider yields bounded positive window/drawable dimensions; the SDL provider uses SDL_GL_GetDrawableSize, and nxgl also requires the drawable to equal the observed EGL surface.
limitations: Positive dimensions are injected by the host fixture and are not physical scanout proof.

requirements.requirement: usar drawable real como dimensão de render/present
requirements.claim: The selected report stores the final positive drawable independently from the requested window, and downstream metrics keep display, drawable, viewport and render target dimensions distinct.
limitations: The adapter remains responsible for applying the measured dimensions to its guest callbacks and viewport.

requirements.requirement: manter ladder RGBA/depth/stencil explícita
requirements.claim: The engine adapter supplies a finite ordered candidate array; nxgl validates every requested RGBA, depth, stencil and double-buffer field and never invents a GLES3 rung.
limitations: Candidate ordering is an engine contract; Horizon, Castle or Sonic ordering is not copied globally.

requirements.requirement: preservar scissor/masks/state em fixes de present
requirements.claim: The alpha-only present path reads framebuffer, scissor, the four-component color mask and clear color, rejects nonzero FBOs and restores the captured values after its clear.

tokens: nxgl must save and restore the full color mask independently

limitations: The state fixture is sealed and synthetic; it does not present a frame through a physical compositor.

requirements.requirement: implementar alpha-one como quirk Amlogic opt-in comprovado
requirements.claim: Opaque backbuffer alpha is disabled by default, requires explicit adapter selection, and in v2 accepts only the exact Amlogic quirk plus its observed alpha-zero reason, a real alpha channel and FBO zero; it is never selected from a device name.

tokens: adapter opt-in plus observed alpha-zero scanout

limitations: No Amlogic compositor or framebuffer is touched; physical activation remains an adapter/device follow-up.

requirements.requirement: deixar NPOT wrap fix desligado por padrão
requirements.claim: nxgl exposes no texture hook and does not rewrite wrap modes; any NPOT workaround remains an adapter-local, evidence-gated opt-in.

tokens: nxgl does not hook texture calls
leave global NPOT wrap rewriting disabled by default

limitations: This gate establishes a default-off framework boundary; it does not diagnose every individual texture artifact.

requirements.requirement: detectar silhueta preta e auditar sampler/wrap antes de shader
requirements.claim: A pure passive classifier routes a geometrically intact black silhouette to sampler, wrap and atlas inspection before shader or lighting speculation, without changing GL state.

tokens: classifier is pure and cannot change GL state
audit sampler and wrap before shader

limitations: The classifier prioritizes investigation; it does not assert sampler root cause without game evidence.

requirements.requirement: não aplicar glFinish globalmente
requirements.claim: The default presentation owner is a strict no-op; glFinish can run only behind an explicit adapter-selected present flag and is never injected merely by linking nxgl.

tokens: Default: the engine/its EGL adapter owns presentation

limitations: An adapter may still opt in after its own narrow evidence; that decision is outside the common default.

requirements.requirement: não limpar FBO, trocar shader ou converter textura globalmente
requirements.claim: nxgl owns neither engine shaders nor texture uploads, default presentation is a no-op, and the only built-in clear rejects off-screen FBOs and requires explicit alpha-one opt-in.
limitations: Game adapters retain responsibility for any narrowly proven shader or texture workaround.

requirements.requirement: validar perda/recriação de contexto e resize/focus
requirements.claim: A passive versioned state machine records focus, minimize, resize, context loss and explicit recreation atomically; it never creates, destroys or shortcuts a native engine context.

tokens: no transition in this module creates or destroys

limitations: The state machine validates observation order only; physical context recreation remains owned by the engine adapter.

requirements.requirement: validar SDL/fbdev, KMSDRM e Wayland por capacidade
requirements.claim: The video matrix keys policy from the backend SDL actually opened, keeps KMSDRM and Wayland under SDL ownership, allows raw fbdev EGL only after present-surface proof and fails unknown stacks closed to SDL. Its passive provider-name prefilter classifies explicit transport capabilities instead of rejecting a GBM-capable object merely because its filename also carries a Wayland token. The opt-in pre-video sanitizer asks the loaded target-ABI SDL which drivers it compiled, preserves supported or absent hints and removes only an unsupported inherited SDL_VIDEODRIVER without selecting a replacement.
limitations: Wayland is a source contract and host boundary in M13; no compositor is opened by the automatic gate.
The sanitizer gate injects the target-SDL inventory and never opens video; each opt-in port still owns physical proof on every claimed firmware and device.

requirements.requirement: registrar vendor/renderer/version/extensions relevantes
requirements.claim: After a current GLES context exists, bounded sanitized report fields capture backend, GL vendor/renderer/version/GLSL/extensions plus EGL vendor/version/client APIs; malformed, unterminated or private provider data fail closed or are redacted.
limitations: All GL strings in the automatic test are fake bounded values, not a host or device renderer fingerprint.

requirements.requirement: criar testes de state preservation e present
requirements.claim: The host suite exercises strict engine-owned no-op behavior, explicit adapter presentation, context-version and policy rejection, the alpha-one state transaction and cross-API present reentry blocking through injected providers and GL functions.
limitations: The dedicated fixture injects every GL/provider function and has no real graphics dependency.

requirements.requirement: cruzar Bully2/Sonic4/Chrono/Castle/LEGO sem generalizar quirks
requirements.claim: The sanitized provenance source admits Horizon, Castle and Sonic only within their recorded scopes, restricts Bully2 to one historical delisted fact, restricts LEGO to alpha-quirk provenance and keeps Chrono negative/designed-only.

tokens: No guest initializer, JNI entry point or game code was executed

limitations: Imported physical history is provenance only and is explicitly not execution performed by M13.

requirements.requirement: medir escala/textura sem assumir resolução
requirements.claim: A pure metrics API preserves display, drawable, viewport and render-target dimensions separately and computes floating-point ratios without assuming an integer scale or fixed resolution.
limitations: The metrics describe dimensions and scale only; texture memory format and engine quality policy remain adapter-owned.

requirements.requirement: expandir matriz de vídeo por stack
requirements.claim: A finite four-row source of truth records opened-backend selection, ownership, entry-point source, present path, drawable rule, baseline, provenance and M13 physical-validation status for fbdev, KMSDRM, Wayland and unknown SDL stacks.
limitations: The matrix separates policy and imported provenance from support; every M13 physical-validation field remains false.

requirements.requirement: documentar fallback e motivo observado
requirements.claim: A bounded attempt journal records finite allowlisted stages and reasons; provider text is excluded, hint recovery is transactional, and the terminal status callback runs under the arbiter before caller outputs are published so reentrant open, close or present returns byte-atomic BUSY.

tokens: Journal text is selected only from this finite table
The terminal callback is part of the open transaction

limitations: The terminal callback must return promptly; the host assertions use deterministic fake providers and contain no physical driver error.

requirements.requirement: fechar gate nxgl
requirements.claim: The dedicated M13 runner closes the host boundary under GCC and Clang sanitizers with pure and sealed nxgl tests, including the default-off target-SDL hint sanitizer plus a separately linked default-off provider probe and one-shot coherent SDL pair transaction; forbidden-symbol, dependency, install-link, infrastructure and frozen-pin barriers remain explicit while physical evidence stays zero.

tokens: live EGL initialize/terminate requires explicit completed-video-teardown attestation
unsupported by the target SDL is removed
removes only an unsupported inherited value

limitations: The closed automatic gate is host-only and uses test-owned fake DSOs; it opens no physical GPU, display, firmware EGL/GLES driver or guest, so physical validation remains assigned to M22.
Version 0.2.17 does not migrate Titan Souls, Swordigo, Bomb Chicken or any other approved port; each adapter must opt in and pass its own firmware and package gates.
The receipt identity recheck detects accidental operational replacement only; it is not a security boundary against malicious or uncoordinated writers during probe-to-reexec.
